name: Emerald Dreamcatcher
summary: In Starbreeze Village, the Emerald Dreamcatcher lies forgotten after the Gnarlpine furbolgs drove out its people. Druids of Ban’ethil Barrow Den gave it to Tallonkai Swiftroot, hoping it would draw vigor from the Emerald Dream.

sections.title: A Gift from Ban'ethil
sections.body: Gaerolas Talvethren, the druidic warden of Ban’ethil Barrow Den, oversaw the making of the Emerald Dreamcatcher. The druids gave the enchanted amulet to only a chosen few. It draws ambient energy from the Emerald Dream, bringing fortune and protection to whoever carries it. When the maddened Gnarlpine furbolgs overran Starbreeze Village, the amulet remained inside a dresser, stranded in hostile, corrupted territory.

faq.q: What does the Emerald Dreamcatcher do?
faq.answer: Tallonkai Swiftroot says the amulet draws raw energy from the Emerald Dream, bringing luck and vitality to whoever possesses it. The Cenarion druids regard it as a rare token of favor.
Gaerolas Talvethren, the druid warden watching over the sleeping Cenarion circle in Ban’ethil Barrow Den, gave the Emerald Dreamcatcher to Tallonkai.

faq.q: Why was the dreamcatcher left behind in Starbreeze Village?
faq.answer: Tallonkai kept the amulet in his dresser in Starbreeze Village. When corruption consumed the local Gnarlpine furbolgs and turned them violent, the settlement had to be abandoned before he could retrieve it.

faq.q: Why are the furbolgs in Starbreeze Village hostile?
faq.answer: The Gnarlpine tribe across Teldrassil has fallen to a dark, spreading corruption that drives its members into an aggressive frenzy. Night elves have been forced to flee outlying settlements such as Starbreeze.

angles.text: As a druid, you can see how the amulet links the sleeping druids of Ban’ethil Barrow Den to the settlements of the Kaldorei below, carrying aid through their communion with the Emerald Dream.
As a night elf, recovering the relic is a small victory against the spreading sickness taking Starbreeze Village and the surrounding boughs of Teldrassil.
